item.title: County Fire Association Delivers annual Toys for Tots
item.description: Fire trucks from 13 of the 14 fire departments in Kosciusko County gathered in the parking lot of JB Furniture on Center Street in Warsaw around 8 a.m. Saturday, Dec. 6, for the annual WNDU Toys for Tots collection.

item.title: Syracuse Public Library – Open House For Kim Blaha
item.description: During the Friends of the Syracuse Public Library’s December coffee social, the community can celebrate retired executive director, Kim Blaha.

item.title: Goshen Housing Developments Hold Ribbon Cutting, Opening Soon
item.description: A new housing development aimed at serving some of Goshen’s most vulnerable residents marked a major milestone with an open house and ribbon-cutting ceremony Wednesday, Dec. 3.

item.title: Fort Wayne Casino Pitch Hits The Statehouse
item.description: The bill before Indiana House members Thursday, Dec. 4 might have been about creating a new casino license for Fort Wayne, but the discussion was far more complicated.

item.title: Indiana’s Congressional Delegation Unites Behind FAA Drone Test Site Bid
item.description: The Hoosier congressional delegation - in a push led by U.S. Senator Todd Young - is urging the Federal Aviation Administration to name Indiana as one of two new national drone test sites.

item.title: Indiana Officials Say Review Found 21 Noncitizens Voting In State
item.description: State officials say a federal agency review found 21 noncitizens have cast ballots in Indiana elections, along with 165 noncitizens who registered to vote in the state.

item.title: Indiana Might Ban Cellphones, Personal Laptops, Smartwatches Bell To Bell
item.description: Since Indiana’s school cellphone ban went into effect in 2024, classroom distractions haven’t disappeared.

item.title: Santa Claus Stops By Syracuse Community Center
item.description: Santa Claus made his list and checked it twice before making a pit stop in Syracuse Saturday, Dec. 6, to have breakfast with children.

item.title: StubHub promised a refund after an emergency
item.description: When Simone Zeno can't attend a j-hope concert because of a family emergency, StubHub agrees to refund her purchase.

item.title: Pierceton Hosts Light Parade
item.description: Residents gathered at Brewer Park in Pierceton for hot chocolate and cookies prior to the start of the Pierceton Light Parade tonight, Saturday, Dec. 6.
